title: CO/BTN facing an early raise
keyIdea: The raiser's range is still strong, but you'll have position. Call a bit wider than early seats, especially suited hands and pairs.

actions.call: JJ-55, AQs-ATs, KQs-KJs, QJs, JTs, T9s, AQo

notes.A5s: A classic bluff raise: the ace blocks AA/AK, and it can still make a straight or the nut flush.
